SPAWN_LARVA.name: Spawn Larva
SPAWN_LARVA.description: Spends energy on a town hall to add Larva after a delay. It shares Queen energy with creep and healing; it does not itself train units.

CREEP_TUMOR.name: Creep Tumor
CREEP_TUMOR.description: Extends creep through a placed tumor. Queen placement costs energy; tumor propagation has its own maturity/use rules. Buried tumors need detection to be targeted normally.

TRANSFUSION.name: Transfusion
TRANSFUSION.description: Spends energy to heal an eligible friendly biological target. Current multiplayer rules constrain use through creep; a target merely being friendly is insufficient.

BURROW.name: Burrow
BURROW.description: Conceals a unit underground, usually stopping movement and normal attacks. Standard Burrow research and unit-specific burrow modes are different unlocks.

EXPLODE.name: Explode
EXPLODE.description: Sacrifices the unit for area damage. Contact, target choice, and friendly spacing affect efficiency; a Baneling cannot resume fighting afterward.

CORROSIVE_BILE.name: Corrosive Bile
CORROSIVE_BILE.description: Delayed point-targeted area damage with interactions against ground, air, and Force Fields. Targets can dodge before impact; the splash can threaten friendly units.

LURKER_BURROW.name: Lurker Burrow
LURKER_BURROW.description: Enables its line-splash ground attack while stationary underground. Detection reveals the Lurker but does not itself stop its weapon.

LUNGE_FRENZY.name: Lunge / Frenzy
LUNGE_FRENZY.description: Mobility burst associated with the researched Hydralisk ability in the cached command set. Requires the relevant late-game unlock; it is not a universal property of unupgraded Hydralisks.

FUNGAL_GROWTH.name: Fungal Growth
FUNGAL_GROWTH.description: Energy-based area damage and movement control. Hitting the area, affected unit rules, and follow-up damage matter.

NEURAL_PARASITE.name: Neural Parasite
NEURAL_PARASITE.description: Researched channeled control over an eligible enemy. The Infestor remains exposed to interruption and must maintain the required relationship with the target.

MICROBIAL_SHROUD.name: Microbial Shroud
MICROBIAL_SHROUD.description: Area protection against specified incoming attacks for units under the cloud. Research and exact protection rules changed across patches; it does not replace anti-air weapons.

SPAWN_LOCUSTS.name: Spawn Locusts
SPAWN_LOCUSTS.description: Produces temporary attackers on a cooldown without spending Larva for each wave. Host safety and the gap between waves are major constraints.

NYDUS_WORM.name: Nydus Worm
NYDUS_WORM.description: Creates a transport exit at a legal visible location. The emerging Worm can be attacked; using Nydus does not make passengers immune or guarantee a successful unload.

GENERATE_CREEP.name: Generate Creep
GENERATE_CREEP.description: After the relevant town-hall tech, a stationary Overlord can supply creep. Moving it stops generation; an Overlord still has no ordinary detection.

TRANSPORT_MORPH.name: Transport morph
TRANSPORT_MORPH.description: Paid transformation into a transport form. The transport role is distinct from the Overseer detector morph.

SPAWN_CHANGELING.name: Spawn Changeling
SPAWN_CHANGELING.description: Spends energy to create a temporary scouting decoy. The Changeling can imitate enemy infantry appearance but does not become a real enemy-controlled unit.

CONTAMINATE.name: Contaminate
CONTAMINATE.description: Temporarily disrupts an eligible enemy structure's production/research. Requires energy and reaching the target; it does not destroy the building.

OVERSIGHT_MODE.name: Oversight Mode
OVERSIGHT_MODE.description: Trades movement for a larger observation area while retaining its detector role. It is a mode of the existing Overseer.

CAUSTIC_SPRAY.name: Caustic Spray
CAUSTIC_SPRAY.description: Channels damage onto an enemy structure. It provides a building-damage option despite the Corruptor's normal anti-air-only weapon.

CONSUME.name: Consume
CONSUME.description: Drains an eligible friendly structure to restore the Viper's energy. It damages an asset and requires time rather than creating free energy without a cost.

ABDUCT.name: Abduct
ABDUCT.description: Pulls an eligible enemy toward the Viper. Eligibility and immunity rules vary; do not assume every large or sieged target can be pulled.

BLINDING_CLOUD.name: Blinding Cloud
BLINDING_CLOUD.description: Restricts affected ranged ground attacks within the cloud. It does not disable every spell or remove aircraft weapons.

PARASITIC_BOMB.name: Parasitic Bomb
PARASITIC_BOMB.description: Applies a damaging area effect associated with an air target. Spreading aircraft limits how many are exposed together.
